summary: Defamation under IPC s.500 based on complaint to SDM; good faith accusation exception (s.499 eighth exception); complaint alleging encroachment and nuisance not defamatory; lawful authority recipient negates defamation; criminal proceedings quashed; High Court's rejection of writ on grounds of delay reversed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order set aside; criminal proceedings quashed and terminated.
